purpose: Final bounded WRN accuracy and SAR comparison matrix, no additional zero gating
initialization: same original W4A4 checkpoint for all7 training branches
optimizer: same AdamW1e-5 to1e-6 cosine schedule,20epochs; BN stats frozen, affine/scales trainable
branches: one matched ordinary native-ADC control plus6 SA/held-aware branches
selection: best validation accuracy then CE, including epoch0; both ranges and all skips reported; test only once after all7 selections frozen
test_history: Previously viewed project test subset; exploratory final matrix, not fresh blind evaluation
zero_gating: disabled for all data-dependent zeros; only unmapped padding columns excluded
detector_model: same deterministic B P-node985ps residual table, signed-d/CM bilinear edge clamp; same rolling reference assumptions
architecture_scope: same three conv layers, fixed mapped request count; partial SAR, no whole conversion skipping
no_additional_experiments: No automatic extension, hyperparameter search or extra network. Report unsuccessful branches too.
energy: report comparison count, valid SA calls, schematic subtotal budget only; no total-system net-energy claim
sparsity: record actual zeros and hypothetical gate opportunity diagnostically; no data gates affect conversion schedule
